privacy: Everything runs on this computer. Your videos are never uploaded.

common.confirmDeleteCompleted: Delete every finished highlight and its files? This cannot be undone.

errors.offline: Can't reach the app. Check that it is still running, then try again.
errors.notFound: This item no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.tooLarge: This file is too large to upload. Try a shorter or smaller video.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again. If it keeps happening, restart the app.
errors.sample: The sample video is not available on this computer.
errors.save: Your change could not be saved. Please try again.

pages.historySubtitle: Every highlight you have started or finished.

docs.noResultsHint: Try fewer or simpler words, for example "slow", "memory", or "graphics card".

aiStatus.partialHint: A model is missing. Open Settings to install it.
aiStatus.offlineHint: Ollama is not running. Highlights still work with basic scoring.

upload.formats: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WebM, or M4V · up to 8 videos, combined into one highlight

create.batchSeparate: A separate highlight for each video ({n} highlights)
create.batchHint: Each video gets its own highlight with these settings. They are made one after another; you can follow them in History.
create.batchHintCrop: Each video gets its own highlight with these settings, and the crop is used for every video. They are made one after another; you can follow them in History.

config.targetHint: The finished video aims for this length. It may be shorter if there isn't enough strong content.
config.noLimit: No limit: let the AI decide
config.noLimitHint: Keeps every clearly strong moment and stops when quality drops off. The highlight is at least the shortest length and never longer than a quarter of the video.
config.noLimitSocial: Not available for a social media short, which has a 60-second limit.
config.rangeSwap: The shortest length is longer than the longest, so the two will be swapped.
config.lengthMissing: Enter a highlight length of at least 1 second.

styleHints.auto: Picks the best moments for this kind of video.
styleHints.informative: Prefers clear explanations and key facts.
styleHints.social: Strong opening hook, made for social media.
styleHints.educational: Keeps lessons and explanations easy to follow.
styleHints.cinematic: Beautiful, well-shot moments with room to breathe; less talking.
styleHints.funny: Reactions, surprises, and punchlines in quick cuts.
styleHints.story: Follows what happened, with enough context to understand each moment.
styleHints.trailer: Strong peaks and openings in short, fast cuts.
styleHints.calm: Gentle, good-looking moments at a relaxed pace.
styleHints.custom: Describe in your own words what to look for.

config.customFocus: What should the highlight focus on?
config.customFocusPlaceholder: For example: focus on the product demo, skip the introduction.
config.visualsOnlyHint: Ignore what is said: no transcription and no subtitles. Moments are chosen from pictures, motion, and sound, with action and visuals preferred. Faster, and good for music, sports, gaming, and travel videos.
config.subtitlesNeedSpeech: Subtitles need speech, which is turned off for this highlight.
config.prioritiesHint: Pick one or more. When you pick several, use the sliders to say how much each one matters.
config.connectionPriorityHint: Favors meaningful affectionate interactions, lets strong moments breathe, and keeps the original scene audio intact.
config.avoidHint: Pick anything you do not want in the highlight. Hover a choice for what it looks for.

filler.label: Filler & greetings
filler.hint: "Um", "hey guys", "welcome back" and other talk with nothing in it.

sponsor.label: Sponsor & ad talk
sponsor.hint: "Sponsored by", "use code", "link in the description" and similar.

swearing.label: Swearing
swearing.hint: Moments where common swear words are said.

talking_heads.label: Long talking heads
talking_heads.hint: A person talking to the camera while little else happens.

dark.label: Dark or blurry shots
dark.hint: Shots that are too dark, blurry, or black.

text.label: Text, titles & slides
text.hint: Title cards, slides, and screens full of text.

screens.label: Screens & phones
screens.hint: Phone, computer, and TV screens, and screen recordings.

empty.label: Empty scenes
empty.hint: Scenes where nobody is there and nothing happens.

intro_outro.label: Intros & outros
intro_outro.hint: The opening and closing seconds, especially greetings, title cards, and sign-offs.

silence.label: Silence & dead air
silence.hint: Stretches where nothing is said or heard.

config.avoidNeedsSpeech: Speech choices need speech, which is turned off.
config.avoidConflict: You asked for people or speech and also to leave out talking heads; close-ups of people talking will be ranked lower.
config.avoidCustomPlaceholder: For example: the car, my boss, prices
config.avoidCustomHint: Separate with commas. Checked against what is said and, when picture matching is installed, what is shown.
config.avoidModeAvoidHint: Matching moments rank much lower but can still fill a gap.
config.avoidModeNeverHint: Clear matches are removed. The highlight can come out shorter.

priorityHints.people: People: favors clear faces, expressions, and people together.
priorityHints.scenery: Scenery: favors landscapes, views, and well-composed shots of places.
priorityHints.fun: Fun: favors laughing, playing, and celebrating.
priorityHints.pets: Pets: favors scenes with animals, especially when they move or play.
priorityHints.music: Music: favors singing, dancing, and performances, and their sound.
priorityHints.sports: Sports: favors plays, goals, tricks, and the reactions to them.

config.quickPresetHint: Choose a starting point, then adjust any setting below.
config.audioFocusHint: Changes moment rankings using loudness and transcript estimates; it does not classify sound events or alter the original mix.
config.audioFocusNaturalHint: Favors audible stretches with less dialogue.
config.audioFocusDialogueHint: Favors stretches with more detected speech.
config.shortestClipHint: Leave empty (Auto) for the default of 1.5 seconds.
config.longestClipAuto: Auto: each clip is as long as its moment needs, up to {cap}. Type a number to set a limit.
config.longestClipSet: Longer moments are cut down to their most important part. Leave empty for Auto.
config.preserveHint: More space keeps the start and end of sentences. Less space makes tighter, faster cuts.
config.allowRepeatHint: Off: the same idea or scene is used only once. On: repeats are allowed up to the limit below.
config.maxRepeatHint: The most time repeated moments may take in total.
config.socialShortHint: Vertical 9:16 video, 15–60 seconds, with a strong opening.
config.makeOneHint: One video with the best moments of the whole source.
config.makeShortsHint: Separate videos, best first. Each short comes from one part of the source, aims for the length above, and never repeats another short's footage. Fewer are made when there are not enough strong moments.
config.reframeSubject: Follow the people in each clip
config.reframeCenter: Keep the middle of the picture
config.reframeSubjectHint: When the shape changes (for example to 9:16), each clip is framed around the faces in it. Clips without a clear face keep the middle.
config.reframeCenterHint: Always keeps the middle of the picture when the shape changes.
config.tightenHint: Applied when the video is created, so the finished video can be a little shorter than the clip list. The preview on the Review page plays clips uncut.
config.tightenNeedsSpeech: Needs speech, which is turned off for this highlight.
config.captionPlainHint: Simple white subtitles, a sentence at a time.
config.captionStyledHint: Short lines with the word being spoken highlighted, sized for the video. On tall (9:16) videos they sit higher, clear of on-screen buttons.
config.frameRate25: 25 fps: TV standard in Europe, India, Australia
config.frameRate30: 30 fps: standard for web and social media
config.frameRate60: 60 fps: very smooth motion for sports and games
config.frameRateHintSource: Keeps motion exactly as recorded. Nothing is converted.
config.frameRateHintSourceKnown: Your video is {fps} fps and stays that way. Nothing is converted.
config.frameRateHintSame: Your video is already {fps} fps, so nothing is converted.
config.frameRateHintEven: Evenly spaced frames of your {fps} fps video are kept to reach {target} fps. Motion stays even and the file gets smaller.
config.frameRateHintUneven: Changing {fps} fps to {target} fps skips a few frames unevenly, so movement can look slightly jerky. Smooth motion avoids this.
config.frameRateHintUp: Your video is {fps} fps. A higher frame rate repeats frames, so motion only looks smoother with smooth motion turned on.
config.frameRateHintUnknown: The video is changed to {target} fps. If your video uses a different rate, frames are repeated or skipped to match.
config.smoothMotion: Smooth motion when changing the frame rate
config.smoothMotionHint: Creates new in-between frames instead of repeating or skipping them. Looks smoother, but creating the video takes much longer, and very fast movement can look slightly blurred.
config.orderHook: Strongest hook first, then in time order
config.subtitleLanguageHint: Translated by your local text model when the video is created. Lines it can't translate keep the original words. Shown as whole lines (no word highlight).
config.levelAudio: Even out the sound (same loudness in every clip)
config.punchIn: Punch-in: every other moment framed a little closer
config.extrasHint: Even sound is recommended: quiet clips are raised and loud ones lowered to the level social apps expect. A logo needs an image, added once and used for every video.
config.rangeHint: Time ranges in the original video, for example 00:32-00:38. Separate several with commas.
config.cropHint: Only the selected area is analyzed and used in the highlight. Your original files are not changed. The same crop is used for every video.
config.analysisNeeded: Turn on video analysis or audio analysis: at least one is needed to choose moments.
config.promptMissing: Describe what you want, or switch to setting it yourself.
config.speechOnlyHint: Do not look at the picture: no video model, picture matching, or scene descriptions. Moments are chosen from what is said and heard. Good for podcasts, talks, and interviews.
config.transitionAuto: Automatic (fade where it jumps, cut where it flows)

progress.title: Analyzing
progress.confirmCancel: Stop working on this highlight? You can start again later, and finished steps are kept.
progress.logsHint: Technical details, useful if something goes wrong.
progress.failedHint: Finished steps are kept, so trying again continues where it stopped.
progress.cancelledHint: Start again to continue. Finished steps are kept.
progress.pausingHint: The current step is being finished and saved. This can take a minute or two on a computer without a graphics card.
progress.pausedHint: Everything finished so far is kept, even if you close the app or turn off the computer. Resume to continue where it stopped.

review.title: Review clips
review.sourceTimeline: Where the clips come from in {name}
review.overTarget: The kept clips are longer than your goal. Remove or shorten a clip, or create the video anyway.
review.scoreHint: How strong the AI thinks this moment is.
review.adjust: Not quite right? Pick new clips that are…
review.adjustHint: This replaces the current clips with a new selection.
review.emptyHint: Try a different style or a longer highlight length.
review.strengthHint: An estimate from the AI scores, not a prediction of views. Opening {opening}, moments {moments}, length fit {length}.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.hint: Tell the voices apart and choose moments of one person. Works best when voices clearly differ; similar voices may be grouped together.
speakers.finding: Listening… this takes a few seconds per minute of speech.
speakers.none: No speech was found in this video.
speakers.speaker: Speaker {letter}

music.title: Background music
music.hint: Add a music file of your own. It plays under the whole video, fades in and out, and is lowered while someone speaks.
music.duck: Lower the music while someone speaks

review.shortOver: This short is longer than your goal. Remove or shorten a clip, or create the videos anyway.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Choose Preview on a clip to watch it here. Nothing is created until you choose Create video.
preview.unsupported: This video can't play in the browser, so it can't be previewed here. You can still change the times and create the video.
preview.startTooLate: To start here, the clip would end before it starts. Move earlier, or set the end first.
preview.endTooEarly: To end here, the clip would end before it starts. Move later, or set the start first.
preview.removedHint: This clip is removed. Keep it to change its start or end here.
preview.momentHint: This moment isn't one of your clips yet. Choose Add under More moments to use it.
preview.hint: Pause where the clip should begin or end, then choose Start here or End here. You can go outside the clip to make it longer. Changes are saved at once.

more.title: More moments
more.hint: Strong moments that aren't in your clips. Preview one, then add it.
more.unavailable: More moments appear once the video has been analyzed.
more.empty: No other strong moments were found. To get a different set, pick new clips below.
more.addLabel: Add the moment from {range} to your clips

postText.title: Text for posting
postText.hint: Titles, a description and hashtags written by your local AI from what is said and shown in the highlight. Check them before posting.
postText.busy: Writing suggestions… On a computer without a graphics card this can take a minute.
postText.simple: Made without the AI model, from the most used words. {note}
postText.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

cover.title: Cover image
cover.hint: A still to use as the thumbnail when you post the video. Pick a suggested frame, or pause the video above where you like and use that frame.
cover.empty: Pause the video above where you like, then use that frame.
cover.usePlayer: Use the frame in the player

watch.title: Watch folder
watch.hint: Videos you put in this folder become highlights automatically, one after another, with the preset you choose. The originals stay where they are.
watch.output: Finished videos are copied to a "highlights" folder inside it. A file is picked up once it has finished copying.

presets.label: My presets
presets.empty: Save these choices as a preset to reuse them for your next video.
presets.nameHint: Keeps the choices below. The crop and time ranges belong to this video and are not saved.
presets.confirmReplace: A preset named “{name}” already exists. Replace it?
presets.applied: Applied “{name}”. You can still change any choice.

notify.hint: Only when this window isn't in front. The tab title also shows ✓ when it's done, or ⚠ if it stops with a problem.
notify.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings to use this. The tab title still shows when it's done.
notify.insecure: Notifications only work when the app is opened at http://localhost. The sound and the tab title still work.
notify.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. The sound and the tab title still work.
notify.failedTitle: The highlight stopped with a problem
notify.bodyGeneric: Open AI Video Highlights to continue.

editorExport.hint: A timeline for Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro that uses your original video files, so you can finish the edit there. No video is created.
editorExport.done: Saved {name}. Open README.txt inside it for how to import the timeline.

localAi.notice: The AI models are not ready yet. Highlights still work, but the AI makes them better.

sectionIntros.optimize: Let the app choose the fastest settings this computer can run well, without lowering quality more than its hardware requires.
sectionIntros.ai: Choose the models that understand your videos. Changes on this page apply right away.
sectionIntros.speech: Turns what is said in your videos into text. Larger models are more accurate but slower.
sectionIntros.video: How scenes are detected and how the finished highlight is saved.
sectionIntros.storage: Space used by this app on this computer. Actions here apply right away.
sectionIntros.system: Used to choose models that fit. Bigger models need more memory and are slower without a graphics card.
sectionIntros.performance: Fine-tune how much memory and processor power the AI uses. The defaults suit most computers.
sectionIntros.connection: Where the AI app (Ollama) runs and how long to wait for it.

optimize.switchHint: Chooses the AI models and speed settings that suit this computer, and updates them if your hardware changes. Video quality, format, and your other preferences are never changed.
optimize.recommendedHint: These differ from your current settings. Turning on automatic optimization applies them.
optimize.reviewHint: Your current values are remembered, so you can undo this.
optimize.upToDate: Your settings already match what this computer runs best.
optimize.offNote: Automatic optimization is off. Your settings stay exactly as they are until you change them.
optimize.managedNote: Automatic optimization is on. A setting you change here is kept as your choice; the others stay automatic.
optimize.undoHint: Restores the AI settings from before it was applied ({when}) and turns automatic optimization off.
optimize.confirmUndo: Restore your previous AI settings and turn automatic optimization off?
optimize.tipsHint: Based on how fast your last analysis ran. These are only suggestions; nothing changes unless you change it.
optimize.noHistory: After your first highlight, suggestions based on its actual speed appear here.

goalHints.quality: The largest models this computer can hold. Analysis takes longer.
goalHints.balanced: Strong models that keep analysis to a reasonable time on this computer.
goalHints.fast: Smaller models for the quickest analysis. They understand a little less.

optimize.goalOffHint: Applies when automatic optimization is on. The recommendation below follows your choice.
optimize.downloadHint: The recommended model is not downloaded yet, so the current one stays in use until it is.
optimize.notManaged: Set on the computer that runs Ollama
optimize.measureHint: Runs each model once (about a minute) to measure real speed. Not possible while a video is being processed.
optimize.estimate: A 10-minute video takes about {time} to analyze with these settings.
optimize.estimatePartial: Parts not measured yet are not included; measure this computer to complete the estimate.

settings.aiIntro: The app uses three local models: one looks at the video, one reads what is said, and one turns speech into text. Nothing leaves this computer.
settings.hardwareHint: Used to choose models that fit. Bigger models need more memory and are slower without a graphics card.
settings.advancedHint: Most people never need to change these.
settings.measured: Measured while a model was running
settings.detected: Estimated from this computer. Run a test to confirm.
settings.testHint: Runs each model once and shows how fast it is.
settings.visionHint: Looks at pictures from each scene to judge what is happening.
settings.textHint: Reads the transcript and picks the most important things said.
settings.whisperHint: Writes down what is said. Larger models are more accurate but slower.
settings.speechSwitchHint: Writes down the speech and picks the most important things said. Turn off when the words don't matter, such as sports, gaming, or music videos: clips are then chosen from sound, movement, and scenes.
settings.visualHint: Uses AI to look at each scene. Turn off for much faster results on computers without a graphics card. Sound, movement, and speech are still used.
settings.visionScope: Which scenes the video model looks at
settings.visionScopeShortlist: Only scenes that could make the highlight (recommended)
settings.visionScopeShortlistHint: Speech is scored first, then the video model checks the promising scenes and every scene without speech. Much faster, especially without a graphics card.
settings.visionScopeAllHint: Slowest. Useful when important moments are purely visual and quiet.
settings.useSpeechHint: Turn speech into text and use what is said to choose moments. Turn off to choose from pictures and sound only: faster, and no subtitles. You can also turn speech off for one highlight on the Create page.
settings.imageMatchingHint: A small picture model (SigLIP) that ranks scenes in a fraction of a second each, so the slower video model only looks at the best ones. It also spots repeated-looking scenes and matches your focus to pictures. It cannot judge what happens in a scene by itself.
settings.imageModelNoRuntime: Needs onnxruntime and tokenizers. Install the app requirements.
settings.embedHint: A small model that compares meaning, to find repeated ideas said in different words and to match your focus. Optional: without it, word matching is used.
settings.ollamaUrlHint: Where the Ollama AI app runs. Keep http://127.0.0.1:11434 when it runs on this computer.
settings.timeoutHint: How long to wait for one answer before giving up on it.
settings.retriesHint: How many times to try again after an AI request fails.
settings.batchHint: Lower uses less memory. It is reduced automatically when it would not fit.
settings.visionCtxHint: Working memory for the video model. Higher allows more scenes per request but uses more RAM.
settings.textCtxHint: Working memory for the speech model. Higher allows more sentences per request but uses more RAM.
settings.threadsHint: How many processor threads the AI may use on this computer.
settings.whisperDeviceHint: Automatic uses an NVIDIA graphics card when available, otherwise the processor.
settings.sceneHint: Lower finds more scene changes, higher finds fewer. Default 27.
settings.codecHint: H.264 plays everywhere. The others make smaller files but some players can't open them.
settings.crfHint: Lower means better quality and a bigger file. 18 looks the same as the original; 23 is a good balance.
settings.storageHint: Space used by this app on this computer.
settings.clearTmpHint: Safe to clear at any time.
settings.clearCacheHint: Changing a highlight afterwards will analyze the video again.
settings.confirmClearCache: Clear saved analysis? Changing an existing highlight will then take longer because the video is analyzed again.
settings.deleteCompletedHint: Removes finished highlights and their videos.
settings.helpIntro: Ollama runs the AI models. Whisper turns speech into text. FFmpeg cuts and saves the video. Everything stays on this computer.
settings.helpCpu: Without a graphics card: install Ollama, keep the address as it is, and use the recommended small models. Highlights still finish; the AI steps just take longer. Turning off "Understand what is on screen" makes it much faster.
settings.helpGpu: With a graphics card: install the latest graphics driver, then Ollama. Click Test AI and check that it says GPU.
settings.helpAmd: AMD graphics: if the test still says CPU, restart Ollama with OLLAMA_VULKAN=1.
settings.helpTrouble: If a model is missing, click Install on its card. If the computer runs out of memory, choose the next smaller model. If FFmpeg is missing, install it and restart the app.
settings.soundMatchingHint: A small sound model (CLAP) that tells what can be heard in each moment (music, laughter, applause, cheering, a dog barking, …) and matches the sounds you ask for. Used when you describe what you want.
settings.director: AI editor (when you describe what you want)
settings.directorHint: Reads every candidate moment with what is said, shown, and heard, and chooses the ones that fit your description.
settings.directorThinkHint: Better choices from models that can reason first (such as qwen3:8b), but it takes several extra minutes without a graphics card.

history.queued: {n} highlights are queued. They are made one after another, and this list updates by itself.
history.emptyHint: Your highlights will appear here once you create one.
history.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}" and its files? This cannot be undone.

prompt.modeLabel: How to set up the highlight
prompt.allSettingsHint: Everything below can still be changed. The AI fills in what your description asks for.
prompt.label: What do you want?
prompt.placeholder: For example: A 45 second vertical video of the best goals and the celebrations, with captions. Skip the warm-up at the start.
prompt.hint: Say what to keep, what to cut, the moments that must be in it, the length, and where it will be posted. Plain words are fine.
prompt.videoHint: Understands scenes, people, actions, and important moments from the picture.
prompt.audioHint: Understands speech and conversations, and labels sounds such as music, laughter, and applause.
prompt.bothHint: With both on, the AI combines what it sees and hears. At least one is needed.
prompt.depthBalancedHint: The video model looks at the most promising scenes, including every scene that looks like what you asked for.
prompt.depthBestHint: The video model looks at every scene. Much slower without a graphics card.
prompt.renderNowHint: Skip the Review page: the video is made as soon as the AI has chosen the moments. You can still change it afterwards.
prompt.understandingHint: This can take a minute on a computer without a graphics card.
prompt.stale: The description changed since it was read. It is read again when you start.
prompt.adjustHint: Change any of these under All settings.
prompt.lengthAuto: As long as the strong moments need
prompt.noPlan: The AI editor was not available, so these clips were chosen from their scores. Asking for a change tries it again.
prompt.askPlaceholder: For example: make it shorter, drop the intro, end on the joke.
prompt.askHint: The AI plans the clips again from the finished analysis. Nothing is analyzed again, so this takes only a few minutes.
prompt.askHintManual: The AI editor plans the clips from the finished analysis, following your words. Nothing is analyzed again.
